parameters.toolDescription: Используй этот инструмент для поиска информации об услугах, ценах, инструкциях и отработки возражений. Обязательно бери из этого инструмента ссылки на видео и таймкоды.

parameters.query:
SELECT 
    l.id AS lead_id,
    l.name,
    l.qualification_summary,
    -- Маппинг полей точно под твои HTTP-узлы:
    l.source_metadata->>'amo_account_id' AS reply_account_id,
    l.source_metadata->>'amo_subdomain' AS reply_subdomain,
    l.source_metadata->>'talk_id' AS reply_talk_id,
    l.source_metadata->>'author_id' AS reply_recipient_id,
    l.source_metadata->>'contact_id' AS reply_contact_id,
    l.source_metadata->>'element_type' AS reply_entity_type,
    l.crm_deal_id AS reply_entity_id,
    
    -- ID чата для формирования ссылки
    ci.external_conversation_id AS reply_chat_id,
    
    -- Сборка истории сообщений
    (SELECT COALESCE(string_agg(msg, E'\n'), 'История пуста') 
     FROM (
       SELECT sent_by || ': ' || text AS msg
       FROM "public"."messages" 
       WHERE lead_id = l.id 
       ORDER BY created_at DESC 
       LIMIT 6
     ) m) AS history_text

FROM "public"."leads" l
LEFT JOIN "public"."channel_identities" ci ON l.id = ci.lead_id
WHERE l.id = {{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.lead_id }}
ORDER BY ci.is_primary DESC, ci.id DESC 
LIMIT 1;

WITH log_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO public.lead_events (
    lead_id,
    event_type,
    event_category,
    workflow_name,
    status,
    payload,
    created_at
  )
  VALUES (
    {{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.lead_id }},
    'consultationstarted',
    'workflow',
    'ConsultationWorkflow',
    'success',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'lead_id', {{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.lead_id }}
    ),
    NOW()
  )
  RETURNING id
),
lead_data AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.id)
    l.id AS internal_lead_id,
    l.external_primary_id,
    l.crm_contact_id,
    l.crm_deal_id,
    l.name,
    l.qualification_summary,
    l.consultation_summary,
    l.lead_status,
    l.source_metadata->>'amo_subdomain' AS subdomain,

    -- Данные для маршрутизации ответа
    ci.external_conversation_id AS reply_chat_id,
    ci.channel AS reply_channel,

    -- Внутренний ID диалога
    c.id AS internal_conv_id

  FROM public.leads l
  LEFT JOIN public.channel_identities ci
    ON l.id = ci.lead_id
  LEFT JOIN public.conversations c
    ON c.lead_id = l.id
   AND c.external_conversation_id = ci.external_conversation_id

  WHERE l.id = {{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.lead_id }}

  ORDER BY l.id, ci.is_primary DESC, ci.id DESC
),
chat_history AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(string_agg(msg, E'\n'), 'История пуста') AS history_text
  FROM (
    SELECT sent_by || ': ' || text AS msg
    FROM public.messages
    WHERE lead_id = {{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.lead_id }}
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 6
  ) sub
)
SELECT * FROM lead_data, chat_history;

UPDATE public.leads
SET
  lead_status = 'consulted',
  current_route = CASE
    WHEN '{{ $('Парсинг ответа ИИ').item.json.recommended_next_step }}' = 'human_handoff'
    THEN 'handoff'
    ELSE 'consult'
  END,
  active_workflow = CASE
    WHEN '{{ $('Парсинг ответа ИИ').item.json.recommended_next_step }}' = 'human_handoff'
    THEN '05_WF_Human_Handoff_Workflow'
    ELSE '04_WF_Consultation_Workflow'
  END,
  needs_human = CASE
    WHEN '{{ $('Парсинг ответа ИИ').item.json.recommended_next_step }}' = 'human_handoff'
    THEN true
    ELSE false
  END,
  handoff_status = CASE
    WHEN '{{ $('Парсинг ответа ИИ').item.json.recommended_next_step }}' = 'human_handoff'
    THEN 'pending'
    ELSE 'not_requested'
  END,
  consultation_summary = '{{ String($('Парсинг ответа ИИ').item.json.result_summary || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  recommended_next_step = '{{ String($('Парсинг ответа ИИ').item.json.recommended_next_step || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  last_status_changed_at = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $('Парсинг ответа ИИ').item.json.lead_id }};

INSERT INTO public.workflow_runs (
  lead_id,
  conversation_id,
  workflow_name,
  trigger_type,
  status,
  input_payload_json,
  started_at
)
VALUES (
  {{ $json.internal_lead_id }},
  {{ $json.internal_conv_id ?? 'NULL' }},
  '04_WF_Consultation',
  'sub-workflow',
  'started',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id AS run_id;
